items.title: Israel Called Gentiles, Strangers, Heathen & Saints
Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time
In Vain Do They Worship Me! Religious Syncretism
Aaron and Israel at the golden calf
items.charge: Idolatry within weeks of the covenant

items.title: Ahab
items.charge: Marrying Jezebel; serving Baal; sparing Ben-hadad whom the Lord appointed to destruction

items.title: Ahaz
items.charge: Burning his children in the fire; copying the altar of Damascus; sacrificing to the gods that smote him

items.title: Ahaziah of Israel
items.charge: Inquiring of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron

items.title: Ahaziah of Judah
items.charge: Walking in the ways of the house of Ahab, his mother being his counsellor to do wickedly

items.title: Amaziah
items.charge: Bringing home the gods of Seir and bowing to them

items.title: Amon
items.charge: Serving his father's idols and refusing his father's repentance

items.title: Antiochus Epiphanes
items.charge: Defiling the temple; forbidding the law; murdering the faithful

items.title: Athaliah
items.charge: Destroying the seed royal of Judah; usurping the throne

items.title: Baasha
items.charge: Walking in the way of Jeroboam after being raised up to destroy Jeroboam's house

items.title: Belshazzar
items.charge: Drinking from the temple vessels and praising the gods of gold and silver

items.title: Demetrius and the silversmiths of Ephesus
items.charge: Raising an uproar over lost trade under the colour of zeal for Diana

items.title: Gideon's ephod
items.charge: Making an ephod from the spoil; Israel whoring after it

items.title: Herod Agrippa
items.charge: Accepting worship due to God alone

items.title: Israel at Baal-peor
items.charge: Fornication with the daughters of Moab; sacrificing to their gods

items.title: Israel in the days of the Judges
items.charge: Serving Baalim and Ashtaroth; intermarrying with the Canaanites; every man doing right in his own eyes

items.title: Jehoram of Judah
items.charge: Slaying all his brethren with the sword; walking in the way of the house of Ahab; making high places and compelling Judah to fornication

items.title: Jehu
items.charge: Executing the house of Ahab, then keeping the calves of Jeroboam

items.title: Jeroboam son of Nebat
items.charge: Two golden calves; priests of the lowest of the people; a feast devised of his own heart

items.title: Jezebel
items.charge: Killing the prophets of the Lord; promoting Baal; witchcrafts

items.title: Jezebel of Thyatira
items.charge: Calling herself a prophetess; teaching the servants of God to commit fornication and eat things sacrificed to idols

items.title: Johanan and the remnant that went down to Egypt
items.charge: Asking the word of the Lord, swearing to obey it, and refusing it; burning incense to the queen of heaven in Egypt

items.title: Judas' soldiers with idol tokens under their coats
items.charge: Carrying things consecrated to idols into battle

items.title: King Solomon
items.charge: Multiplying foreign wives; building high places to their gods

items.title: Manasseh
items.charge: Rebuilding the high places; altars to the host of heaven in the temple; passing his sons through the fire; witchcraft; filling Jerusalem with innocent blood

items.title: Micah's idols and the tribe of Dan
items.charge: A house of gods, a hired Levite, and a tribe that stole both

items.title: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego
items.charge: Refusing to fall down and worship the golden image; not careful to answer the king in this matter

items.title: The captivity of Israel (the northern kingdom)
items.charge: Two centuries of the sins of Jeroboam; secret sins; idols, high places, and children through the fire

items.title: The Chaldeans who accused the Jews
items.charge: Informing against the Jews to have them cast into the furnace for keeping the second commandment

items.title: The church in Pergamos
items.charge: Holding among them the doctrine of Balaam and the doctrine of the Nicolaitans

items.title: The elders with idols in the temple (Ezekiel 8)
items.charge: The image of jealousy; creeping things on the walls; women weeping for Tammuz; twenty-five men worshipping the sun with their backs to the temple

items.title: The Jew who sacrificed at Modin
items.charge: Sacrificing on the heathen altar at the king's command

items.title: The Midianites, in the matter of Peor
items.charge: Beguiling Israel with their wiles into fornication and the worship of Baal-peor

items.title: The Philistines and the captured ark
items.charge: Setting the ark of God in the house of Dagon, and keeping it seven months

items.title: The priests of Bel
items.charge: Deceiving the king and the people with an idol that seemed to eat

items.title: The prophets of Baal at Carmel
items.charge: Prophesying in the name of other gods
